title: E-FRC-0155: a string tension from the coupled Sigma(648) field: at the one stationary ordered point the loops rise...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0155 in the gauge arena: a string tension from the coupled Sigma(648) field: at the one stationary ordered point the loops rise far above the noise but the field is deconfined (Polyakov 0.58, chi(2,2) -0.08, chi(3,3) 0.27), with no put-in tension the coupled field holds a flux string within a few links of taut (excess 0.9 to 2.6, against 4,207 uncoupled) and pays for it with energy rising about 21 per unit length, and a cold meson at tension x beta 4.2 binds and moves as a pair but only 4.2 in 600 beats, so three gates fail.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
